issues.problem: The supplied r16 studio close-ups (c_nacelle_left, c_ge_inboard_left, c_canoes_left, c_canoe_side, c_wing_panel) were rendered from the repo's dist/test.html (dated 14:01, 0 occurrences of 'GE monogram'), not the r16 build: they show no GE monogram, no strake, no access panel. Re-rendered with CABIN_PAGE=scratchpad/b/test.html they differ in 30-88 % of pixels and show all three. Not a model defect, but any rater using the supplied c_* images will mark a false monogram / strake regression.
issues.fix: Always run studio renders as CABIN_PAGE=<build>/test.html node test/studio.js <out> review/spec_ext.json (test/studio.js line 13 defaults to dist/test.html). Optionally make studio.js print the page path and refuse a dist/ page older than src/.

issues.detail: wing near-far value (owner: lighting, not scored)
issues.problem: The r2 albedo scaling of specEnv (04_shaders.js, after 'vec3 specEnv') has no effect on the wing: w19A near flap 162 / far skin 171, vs r15 163 / 172; KN41 falls 194 -> 146. clamp(luma(v_col)/0.39, 0.5, 1.0) saturates at 1 for every baked wing value at or above the #636466 reference, so only very dark verts are scaled.
issues.fix: 04_shaders.js: normalise to the brightest wing albedo, not the darkest: clamp(luma(v_col) / luma(nearRootAlbedo), 0.55, 1.0) (pass the reference in a uniform), or scale specEnv by a distance term mix(1.0, 0.7, smoothstep(10.0, 40.0, length(v_wpos - u_eye))) on the exterior.

issues.problem: The dome front sits ~40 % aft along the fan cowl (LALF _137 ~28 %), and there is no saddle behind the dome before the rise to the strut.
issues.fix: l.448: start the sections at x 1.55 and nose = sqrt(smooth(1.55, 2.2, x)); l.451: ridge smooth(1.55, 2.0, x) for the 0.40 term, and add - 0.10 * Math.exp(-(((x - 3.4) / 0.55) ** 2)) for the saddle.

issues.detail: canoe K side: far pods and crown step
issues.problem: Far pods unchanged at 82/93 (0.48-0.54 of the skin) with a dark flank from top to keel, where _7250's far pods have a pale upper flank; the near pod drops from crown 211 to flank 131 within 3 px.
issues.fix: l.478: soften the depth ramp lerp(1, 0.6, smooth(0.04, 0.5, dy)) -> lerp(1, 0.65, smooth(0.10, 0.65, dy)) and the top blend smooth(0.15, 0.5, n[1]) -> smooth(0.0, 0.5, n[1]) so the upper flank is a broad lit band; keep the 0.40 floor.

issues.problem: w11K liner 118 -> 81: the right direction, but knav _9 falls to ~10 at the fan; the inner lip-to-throat transition is still a mid-grey tube.
issues.fix: l.383: 1 - 0.55 * smooth(0.15, 1.0, depth) -> 1 - 0.7 * smooth(0.25, 1.2, depth), lip end unchanged so the 11A throat keeps 43-53.
